title: Valid Point-of-Service Entry Mode Codes
applicability: Applies through Variable Information Element 113, typically carried in Segment 111 Table ID 005, and affects Segment 100 transaction context and lifecycle correlation.

businessRequirements.title: POS Entry Mode Element 113 shall contain a valid two-digit PAN Entry Mode followed by a valid one-digit Terminal Capability Mode.
PAN Entry Mode shall use a source-defined value consistent with the card-entry method and transaction context.
Terminal Capability Mode shall reflect the POS PIN, EMV, contactless, or mPOS capability hierarchy.
POS Entry Mode shall persist across lifecycle transactions except for source-defined exceptions, including PAN mode 90 referenced by a completion or void using mode 02.
Entry Mode 10, 82, and terminal capability mode 3 shall be used only in their source-defined card, network, and mPOS contexts.

testCases.positive: Entry mode agrees with card/POS context
negative: Mode 10 used for first credential storage
Mode 82 used for prohibited stored-card context
mPOS mode 3 used without applicable mPOS context

testCases.positive: Follow-up preserves original entry mode or source-defined 90-to-02 exception
